overview: The Council approved $1,386,000 in free cash capital appropriations for citywide infrastructure and vehicle leases following contentious debate over council rules, as well as $90,000 for repairs at the Brooks Estate. Councilors also approved utility conduit petitions, addressed taxi licensing and cable access issues, and passed resolutions concerning a holiday nativity display and administrative changes at the Curtis-Tufts School.

items.title: Free Cash Capital Appropriation of $1,386,000 (Item 14-743)
items.summary: Tabled under Council Rule 20 after a motion to sever individual line items for separate votes failed.

items.title: Brooks Estate Repairs Appropriation (Item 14-744)
items.summary: Tabled under Council Rule 20 upon councilor request.

items.title: Comcast Conduit Hearing: Hall Avenue and Governors Avenue (Item 14-733)
items.summary: Approved Comcast's petition to install underground conduit across Hall Avenue to service 75 Governors Avenue.

items.title: Reconsideration and Approval of Free Cash Appropriation (Item 14-743)
items.summary: After upholding the Council President's ruling that previous rules had been suspended, the Council debated the line items and approved the $1,386,000 appropriation with several reporting amendments.

items.title: Brooks Estate Repairs Appropriation (Item 14-744)
items.summary: Approved $90,000 from certified free cash for structural, roof, and sprinkler repairs at the Brooks Estate Carriage House and Manor.

items.title: Comcast Conduit Hearing: Almond Street and Salem Street (Item 14-734)
items.summary: Approved Comcast's petition to install underground conduit along Almond Street to Salem Street to connect local businesses.

items.title: Sign Appeal: Avalino's Restaurant (Item 14-738)
items.summary: Approved a petition reversing a sign denial to allow secondary signage and an awning for Avalino's Restaurant's new function room.

items.title: Taxi Operator Licenses (Items 14-739, 14-740, 14-741)
items.summary: Approved taxi operator licenses for Kilsoy P. Glaude, Ishmael Hussain, and Nicholas Fritz, with Hussain and Fritz approved after initially being tabled until they arrived.

items.title: Nativity Scene at Royall House Park (Item 14-735)
items.summary: Passed a resolution requesting the Mayor return the Christmas nativity scene to Royall House Park for the holiday season.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: Adopted condolence resolutions and observed a moment of silence for deceased Medford residents Chris Travis, Frederick W. Roach, Bernie McGovern, John Murphy, Vincenza Sincardi, and Deborah Gaglione.

items.title: Roadway Restoration Standards (Item 14-746)
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the City Engineer provide councilors with city standards and regulations governing contractor roadway repairs.

items.title: Warning Sign Replacement at 24 Walter Street
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the Department of Public Works replace an old children warning sign at 24 Walter Street.

items.title: Reverse 911 Notification and Cable Access Status (Item 14-742)
items.summary: Heard citizen comments on reverse 911 usage and approved a motion requesting the City Solicitor report on pending cable litigation and franchise contract negotiations.

items.title: Tree Planting Program (Item 14-737)
items.summary: Received and placed on file an informational update on the city's project planting over 100 trees across Medford.

items.title: Curtis-Tufts School Administrative and Financial Inquiry
items.summary: Passed an amended resolution requesting salary and job details for new and reassigned administrators at Curtis-Tufts School along with per-pupil expenditure and outside revenue figures.
